question: Which of the following methods is the quickest way to open an existing MS PowerPoint presentation?

options.text: Double-click the .pptx file in File Explorer
Open MS PowerPoint and click Blank Presentation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Double-click the .pptx file in File Explorer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Double-clicking a .pptx file** in File Explorer directly opens the presentation in MS PowerPoint.
 
• This method bypasses the need to manually launch PowerPoint and select the file, saving time and effort.
 
• It is the most straightforward way for users already familiar with File Explorer navigation.
 
• Supported file formats include .pptx, .ppt, and other PowerPoint-compatible extensions, ensuring seamless compatibility.
 
• Make sure MS PowerPoint is set as the default program for opening .pptx files for this method to work effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **.pptx File Format**

 
 
• .pptx is the default file extension for Microsoft PowerPoint presentations created in versions 2007 and later.
 
• It is based on the Open XML format, which provides better data compression and improved recovery options.
 
 
 
• **Default Program Settings**
 
 
• To open a .pptx file by double-clicking, ensure MS PowerPoint is set as the default program for this file type.
 
• On Windows, this can be adjusted through the "Default Apps" settings in the system menu.
 
 
 
• **Keyboard Shortcuts for MS PowerPoint**
 
 
• Ctrl + O: Opens the file explorer to locate and open a presentation.
 
• Alt + F4: Closes the currently active window or application.
 
 
 
• **File Explorer Navigation**
 
 
• Windows File Explorer is used to navigate, organize, and manage files, including PowerPoint files.
 
• It provides a graphical user interface for quick access to files stored on a computer.
